jsonLd.description:
Spectacular VIEWS of city/mountain/water in Point Grey, this home was redesigned & completely renovation over $500,000 in 2014. Well-maintained. Features: 3 levels with 4 bedrooms; Bright, open & gracious layout, vaulted ceilings & skylights, radiant heat, Hardwood & tile flooring thru-out. Open kitchen equipped with European appliances WOLF etc. Family rm (can be used as recreation rm) on 2nd flr & huge Master bdrm (ensuited) on top flr with views! Just one block from Queen Mary Elem. & park. 5 minutes drive to WPGA private school, Golf Course & beach parks. Quick access to UBC, Downtown, shopping etc. Perfect for growing family!

Pets allowed, require half month pets deposit
No smoking
Available on Oct.1st, 2026
Lease term, minimum one year lease
Rent:$7,999/m plus utilities

Requirements:
- Extensive Background Check including the Requirement of 2 Pay Stubs
- Complete Credit Check
- References Required
- Minimum One Year Lease which converts to Month to Month at the end of the Lease period.
- Damage Deposit is half Month's Rent.
- Tenant insurance required

If you are interested, please reply to this post with some general information such as:
1. Who would be occupying the suite
2. When you would like to start the tenancy
3. Your employer, net monthly income
4. If you are a smoker, your hobbies
5. The best phone number to reach you at (our clients need this information to consider all serious applications).
do NOT contact me with unsolicited services or offer
